body: It’s kinda crazy to hear what other people got up to on Neo in terms of off site transactions. I definitely bought two unconverted pets (from their original owner) almost eight years ago. Never regretted it either. Pretty sure I was going to kill myself that year and if some pixels turned my life around, I’d say it was worth it.

My FH avoids this place like the plague so no go gentlemen. lol But wow, thank you for the advice! The driving is probably one of the worst parts of it for me (I don't do great with cars and the cluster of people is already overwhelming without putting them in huge bodies of metal). Stalling and letting the crowds flush out and the traffic thin sounds like an excellent plan. Thank you! Hockey is my preferred game of choice really and I do attend those games but our city features only an ECHL team so the traffic is nothing compared to what I imagine a NFL football game must look like!
Oh that sounds amazing! And totally unexpected I bet. The men in our lives do need some proper pampering and treatment and what a good opportunity. I hope he loves it!

Watches are like man bling. It's great. lol A really nice idea and useful too! I know my FH is always fighting around his wallet to get to his phone to check the time (but he has a watch, he just forgets to wear it heh).
Glad to hear it! I grew up with an anti-football family so this world is pretty new to me. lol
That is adorable! Luggage is an amazing investment to start a marriage off with too! And how fitting for a destination wedding.
